cases.text: Actual Root os.close error: the exact caught exception and its original traceback must occupy prospectively owned fields BEFORE error_fact/str/getattr/fault append/notification. Full ordinary/native/cold data readers see those same original objects; a class/message/errno copy is not the original.

With original close error, a failing error_fact projection must preserve BOTH actual original close and projection errors/tracebacks in the same row cell. No second projection is attempted to retain the secondary; UNKNOWN/occupied credit is not completed.

Failure appending wire fault or notifying after close projection retains the actual new exception while original close stays strong. Row/attempt/current and initial TB aliases remain visible; no replacement terminal fact certifies the failure path.

History append/status failure occurs after close claim but before syscall: original active row/credit and actual metadata error survive, no syscall receipt is guessed, later close_one/close cannot replay the claimed generation or close a reused integer.

One successful actual os.close sets close_returned before fallible CLOSED metadata/pop. Only confirmed original grant removal permits release; unchanged wire status/attempt/history and actual closed book/raw cells remain strongly owned through full native transfer.

Successful actual close followed by status/pop/publication failure preserves original return marker and actual metadata exception. Claimed close cannot replay, original pending fd_rows/credit or incomplete receipt prevents false Source end. Numeric EBADF probes cannot repair publication.

Actual syscall close error retains original exception/TB and UNKNOWN row/grant. Original FDState.unknown prohibits further acquisition under that unknown domain; no retry, EBADF inference, refund, CLOSED rewrite or local manager retirement.

A pair/acquire factory error is stored on each actual prospective row before cancellation. No-return rows retain complete actual history and aliases; original exception is shared, not copied, and one row cannot silently lose its factory prefix.

No credit, growth failure, cell/map allocation failure or incomplete publication must not call a descriptor factory. A before-generation uncertain prefix keeps prepare_pending and its actual Source/native roots; same book cannot overwrite its generation cell or certify an absent FD/end.

After actual generation advance, complete cancellation alone yields known NO_RETURN and may clear pending. Failed cancellation/retained_journal/secondary enrollment stores its actual secondary error while the original publication exception remains in every cell. No original row/state history is erased.

Original fstat/get_inheritable/identity failure is captured before any fallible projection. Projection failure remains actual and chained; finally performs one original cleanup. Its separate original close or cleanup error/TB is retained raw, not summarized/discarded.

Ordinary post-projection _changed failure retains the actual error with its original HELD row/credit, before propagation to incoming native originals. There is no successful FD/owner lifecycle receipt inferred from a locally correct metadata projection.

Prepared-output acquisition/close uses unchanged real native birth/OFD/keeper/close bank. Thrown native metadata original is retained in Source cell; native prepared outcome query failure retains its own real secondary. No Source close_returned flag supersedes native actual close/end or UNKNOWN.

Destination precharges original cell index storage on SAME grant, then inserts SAME cell/row/attempt before destination row publication. Partial transfer preserves original owner's row and both actual map aliases. No new row/generation/error reconstructed or overwritten.

History codec/rows/meta/faults and common.error_fact output stay original JSON DATA. Raw exceptions/TB reside only on actual Source error_cells; all exposed status/attempt/tuple/field/identity9/no-return absences remain exact and full wire primary body joins still agree.

After confirmed manager/book removal from local_owners, complete_owner_graph MUST retain the actual FDState root with original attached book/cell/error/traceback/row/attempt aliases. A wire-only FDState.graph or error-count receipt cannot replace full Source native/cold DATA.

RootOwnedFile and owned_sample must retain actual manager/book/credit when hold.release is False. Empty book.fds alone cannot retire the owner; original Source/native pending row remains valid and full error roots stay visible.

Added zero-slot read reservation uses same original Root pool, commits actual declared pass and requires release True. Partial reserve/append/commit/release failure retains actual prefix/credit; FDState and history completion refuse unclosed custody holds. No synthetic cleanup retry or new allowance.

Existing Root grow/check/sample uses preowner FD acquisitions. Added PreObserverHash storage growth must not recursively call RootObserver.check/grow/sample; same original native token and attached allocation/live/peak mirror stay consistent before factory and after partial native/Source mirror failure.

Before/after Root attachment, sampling error storage is charged via SAME native master grow and existing read_debit. PID/closed/token/mirror errors precede acquisition. Native retained+pending aggregate, cumulative read/hash, caps and whole deadline cannot reset or issue a second pool.

Actual full encoder/secondary cuts/native Source and dictionary consumers must read cell's original fields plus error cause/context/TB/frame/code/locals and exact alias pointers. Missing binding/foreign/unsupported data stays unresolved; generic Source label, count or projected error is insufficient.

Normal and every early/error Root outcome must reach the unchanged actual CommandReceive/cold_complete/prebound FinalReceive with original roots. Missing terminal is incomplete. Full body/error/native bank/index reread and Source/config/runtime/FD/region/utility ends remain mandatory before original transfer.

No original cell/map/history clears before actual completed full-data receipt and exact FD/slot/credit end. Pending preparation or unclosed custody read hold must stop retirement BEFORE deleting row IDs. Confirmed error transfer is not author self-acceptance or native outside end.

SOL135 exact prior RootOwnedFile/no-contextlib ordinary body errors, standalone consumer FD scope and lazy bounded Source cursor must remain unchanged on this coherent candidate. Inherited controls remain full text SHA NOT_RUN; old CLOSE_CUSTODY_OPEN is a pinned baseline, not an unchanged new-candidate result.

Original69 plus mandatory20 four complete raw-LF definitions/caps/thresholds/scenarios remain byte-equal. All inherited92 plus new meaningful cases remain NOT_RUN under ABSTRACT_HASH_ONLY; no collection or test simulation is acceptance, and no old run attaches to new bytes.

8192 cell allocation/1024 metadata read per birth/transfer are pre-effect declarations only. Actual allocator/map growth/GC/refcount/projection/full TB and graph/body/native/cold costs plus original API/ABI workload and finite nonmutation interval need independent same-pool whole qualification. Unknown is not zero or a waived cap.
